text:
jonathan: Quick follow-up from the FinOptics postmortem — the isolation bug that caused their on-prem peering to flap. Need clear owners + timelines for the three remediation buckets: 1) short-term mitigation, 2) durable fix for the peering handshake, 3) runbook + alerts. Who can take ownership?

ellie: I can own the short-term mitigation (prefix-level throttling + aggressive failover). Will validate by EOD Thu.

samir: I'll pair with ellie for the mitigation test script and add an automated rollback if handshake errors spike. ETA: Mon 9am PT for a test in staging.

sylvie: For the durable fix (handshake race on the edge device), I can own the patch and the regression tests. Targeting next sprint; can we get a canary window the week after?

jonathan: Thanks. Can we enumerate the concrete deliverables so we can put them in JIRA? My suggestion: A1: mitigation config + validation, A2: edge handshake patch + regression suite, A3: runbook + alert thresholds + oncall play.

maria: I'll create the JIRA tickets and link them to PM-1872 (FinOptics postmortem). Assigning A1->ellie, A2->sylvie, A3->samir.

ellie: For A1 I'll submit the config diff:```\n# throttle incoming peering SYN flood\nnet.peer.throttle.enabled = true\nnet.peer.throttle.rate = 50/s\n```\nPlan: apply to edge-rack-7 in prod-cage for 1h during low traffic, monitor KV cache hit rate and RT.

samir: Noted. I'll wire an alert that triggers when handshake_failure_rate > 0.5% for 5m and auto-disable the new throttle if rollback condition met.

sylvie: Canary request: can we run the handshake patch against the FinOptics staging appliance (they gave us an image) before we push internal canary? Prefer Wed morning.

jonathan: OK — timeline recap: A1 (ellie) validation EOD Thu; A2 (sylvie) patch ready for internal canary Wed next week; A3 (samir) runbook + alerts Mon 9am. Maria to create tickets now.

infrastructure note: infra-bot: scheduled job infra-checker started for edge-rack-7 canary window -> job id job-8842

infra-bot: Deploy window reserved: 2026-04-06T02:00Z -> notify #eng-oncall 48h prior.

maria: Tickets created: FIN-452 (A1), FIN-453 (A2), FIN-454 (A3). Added checklists + owners. Linking to postmortem doc link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/PM-1872

samir: I'll add a test harness to simulate the peering flapping pattern we've seen (bursty SYNs + intermittent NAT translations). Sharing soon.

ellie: Quick note — during the postmortem we saw recurring pattern across 3 customers: onprem NAT + asymmetric routing -> connection reset w/ delayed feedback. We should consider a cross-customer audit after A1 is live.

jonathan: Good catch. Add cross-customer audit as backlog item in FIN-454 (samir). If A1 proves effective, we'll schedule the audit in the following 2 weeks.

sylvie: Will also include a unit test for the handshake race (replicates delayed SYN-ACK path).

jonathan: Final ask — weekly check-in for this thread until all items closed. I'll ping a progress update every Wed 10am PT. Short updates only: status / blocker / next step.

maria: Added recurring calendar invite.

ellie: Status update (Tue): mitigation config staged in prod-cage, smoke tests passing, pushing to canary at 03:00Z.

samir: Test harness attached to FIN-452, running 5k synthetic handshakes now. Will post results in the ticket. :eyes:

sylvie: Patch draft up at https://github.com/redwood-inference/edge/compare/finoptics-handshake-fix — requesting review from @jonathan and @ellie.

jonathan: Perfect. Thanks everyone. We'll close the loop after the canary and the runbook is published. :shipit:
